_comment: The cross-listed / foreign-filer tier. Hand-curated on purpose.
config.XSECT_UNIVERSE points at D:/stock_xsect_data/universe.parquet, which is a
44-million-row daily liquidity screen carrying no CIK, no sector and no
sub-industry. Loading a company from it produces exactly the failure CLAUDE.md
records under '--symbols used to silently rewrite a company's PROFILE': an empty
sub_industry is not thin data, it changes which sub-tests the company is even
asked. So this tier is a named list with its classification attached.
SCOPE LIMIT, STATED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED LATER: these are 20-F filers reporting
under IFRS. clab/fundamentals/tags.py resolves us-gaap tags, so the MEASURED half
returns NO_DATA for them, coverage falls below MIN_COVERAGE_FOR_BAND and the band
is INSUFFICIENT_DATA. They appear in the external-intelligence workbook and in
their industry objects; they do NOT appear in the composite ranking. That is the
correct honest outcome and not a bug. Full IFRS tag support is separate work.

members.name: ASML Holding N.V.
members.why: The confirmed-moat calibration case. EUV lithography has no second supplier, so replication difficulty is the thing external evidence is supposed to be able to establish.

members.why: The customer side of semiconductor_equipment and the foundry ASML's tools are bought for. Without it the equipment industry object has no demand-side counterparty in the book.
